stem.en: ABC Bakery can rent a shop near the busy market or one in a quiet lane. What does it give up and what does it get if it picks the market?

text.en: It pays more rent, and more people walk past the shop.
It pays less rent, and fewer people walk past the shop.
It pays more rent, and it no longer needs to sell online.
It pays the same rent, and it gets cheaper flour.

explanation.en: A busy area brings more people past the shop, which can mean more customers. In real life, a shop there usually costs more rent than one in a quiet lane.

hints.en: Think about the crowd near a market, and what rent a shop owner there will charge.
